name: Black Men
overview: Scripture presents a vivid portrayal of divine authority and protection amidst adversity, as seen in the tumult of enemies rising against God's people (Psalms 83:2) and the majestic imagery of the Ancient of Days with hair like pure wool (Daniel 7:9). The Lord’s guidance and providence are evident in His care for the vulnerable, instructing Joseph to flee into Egypt to protect the Christ child (Matthew 2:13). The passages emphasize God as the unchanging source of every good gift (James 1:17) and reveal His powerful presence symbolized by feet like fine brass and a voice like many waters (Revelation 1:15), underscoring His sovereign strength and faithfulness.
